name: DropTrack
tagline: Analyze tracks and work with your DropTrack music catalog
description: Connect Cline to your DropTrack account through the official remote MCP server. Analyze tracks, search your catalog, inspect audio metadata, work with playlists, and manage customer-facing music-promotion workflows.

install.notes: Sign in with your DropTrack customer account when Cline opens the OAuth authorization flow.
